english.title: Postal service - send creature / article / thing by post
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sent by post a postal packet, namely **(..SPECIFY..), enclosing a

(A)_[creature, namely **(..SPECIFY CREATURE..)]_
(B)_[article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..)]_
(C)_[thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..)]_

of a kind which was likely to injure other postal packets in the course of their transmission by post or any person engaged in the business of a postal operator
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85(1) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
